fields.v: Yes (1): eight models (and three scaffolds) evaluated as alternatives on the same 217 instances, checklists, scaffold defaults and judges; no 'no-instruction' baseline condition
fields.quote: In the main experiment, we evaluated eight mainstream models on OCTOBENCH.
fields.why: Q7 asks for a baseline or an alternative under the same conditions; eight models and three scaffolds run under identical conditions arguably satisfy it fully, so Partly for lacking a no-instruction baseline may be stricter than the rule.
fields.doubt: A Q7 pergunta por 'baseline ou alternativa' nas mesmas condições. Oito modelos e três scaffolds correm nas mesmas 217 instâncias, checklists e juízes (pág. 6 e 12). Decide se a falta de uma condição sem instruções justifica Parcial ou se deve ser Sim.
